acceptanceCriteria: Cargo metadata and release/versioning guidance identify v0.2.77 while retaining v0.2.76 as the preceding public baseline.
Release CI produces identity-bound five-target artifacts and supply-chain receipts for v0.2.77.
Public adopter and N-1 acceptance use only v0.2.77 downloaded artifacts, prove forbidden-root isolation and temporary-run cleanup, and exercise the released binary against this repository.
The release starts from a synchronized ready default branch and changes no Runtime behavior, object repository, global Agent/MCP configuration, failed-tag history, or unrelated evidence.
Any release or adopter failure preserves immutable release truth and records a failure receipt without source checkout, workspace binary, or moving-branch fallback.
goal: Release v0.2.77 without changing Runtime behavior, bind all release evidence to the published artifacts, and prepare a read-only acceptance handoff for the object repository.
intent: Publish v0.2.77 from the reviewed synchronized default branch, then validate immutable public artifacts and provide the released Runtime for object-repository recovery acceptance.

scenarioCoverage.expected: published v0.2.77 artifacts and their post-release adopter evidence remain identity-bound and isolated
scenarioCoverage.scenario: immutable public release and adopter acceptance
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: run the release policy, artifact integrity, documentation, and post-release adopter acceptance checks against the published tag
